source_title: FRA Quarterly Report FY2024 Q4, Appendix D, Table 5 (pp. 70–71)

ADA.label: Passenger accessibility assistance
ADA.explanation: Delays involving wheelchair lifts, service animals, or other passenger accessibility needs

CON.label: Hold for guaranteed connection
CON.explanation: Waiting for connecting trains or buses

CTC.label: Train-control system failure
CTC.explanation: Failure of Centralized Electrification and Traffic Control (CETC)

HLD.label: Passenger or baggage delay
HLD.explanation: Delays associated with passengers, checked baggage, or large groups

INJ.label: Injured or ill person
INJ.explanation: Passenger or employee injury or illness

ITI.label: Initial terminal delay
ITI.explanation: A late incoming train delays equipment release at the originating terminal

MTI.label: Disabled train ahead
MTI.explanation: A mechanically disabled train blocks or delays another train

OTH.label: Other Amtrak operating delay
OTH.explanation: Miscellaneous operating causes, including loss of time while running

SYS.label: Crew and operating-system delay
SYS.explanation: Crew availability or other crew-related problems

UND.label: Undefined delay
UND.explanation: Automatically entered two-minute delay with no further specified cause

CTI.label: Commuter train interference
CTI.explanation: Waiting for or following commuter trains

CTP.label: Commuter train problem
CTP.explanation: Unusual operating problems involving commuter trains

DBB.label: Defective bridge/building work
DBB.explanation: Unscheduled bridge or building maintenance due to a defect

DCS.label: Communications and signal defect
DCS.explanation: Signal or crossing-protection faults and related communications/signal disruptions

DCT.label: Defective concrete ties
DCT.explanation: Replacement of defective concrete railroad ties

DDA.label: Defect-detector activation
DDA.explanation: Train inspection following a defect-detector activation

DET.label: Electrical system defect
DET.explanation: Unscheduled catenary or other electrical-system maintenance

DMW.label: Unscheduled track maintenance
DMW.explanation: Track repairs or maintenance-of-way activity following a defect

DSR.label: Temporary slow order
DSR.explanation: A temporary speed restriction, excluding heat and cold orders

DTR.label: Detour
DTR.explanation: A train is delayed by operating on a detour route

FTI.label: Freight train interference
FTI.explanation: Delays caused by freight train movements

PBB.label: Planned bridge/building maintenance
PBB.explanation: Scheduled work on bridges or buildings

PET.label: Planned electrical maintenance
PET.explanation: Scheduled catenary or other electrical-system work

PTI.label: Other passenger train interference
PTI.explanation: Waiting for or following passenger trains other than commuter trains

RTE.label: Routing or dispatching
RTE.explanation: Dispatching, diversions, late track bulletins, and other routing issues

TCD.label: Third-party contractor activity
TCD.explanation: Unplanned contractor activity affecting train service

BSP.label: Bridge strike
BSP.explanation: A train striking an overhead bridge

CUI.label: Customs and immigration
CUI.explanation: Customs or immigration processing in the United States or Canada

DBS.label: Debris strike
DBS.explanation: Train delays resulting from debris strikes or related damage

MBO.label: Movable bridge opening
MBO.explanation: Marine traffic opening a movable bridge without a bridge failure

NOD.label: Unused schedule recovery time
NOD.explanation: Waiting until a scheduled departure time after arriving early

POL.label: Police or fire activity
POL.explanation: Police or fire department holds on or near the right-of-way or aboard a train

TRS.label: Trespasser or grade-crossing incident
TRS.explanation: Trespassers, animals, crossing collisions, vehicles on tracks, and related incidents

UTL.label: Utility company failure
UTL.explanation: Problems caused by utility company systems or operations

WTR.label: Weather and environmental conditions
WTR.explanation: Severe weather, floods, landslides, earthquakes, and heat or cold orders
